summary: Frontend-only verification completed for emergency startup override and debug-APK wiring. Testing Screen renders immediately in mobile preview, static/source checks pass, and requested Gradle/workflow/font safeguards are present.

integration_issues.flow: Debug APK on-screen runtime console visibility
integration_issues.issue: StartupConsoleOverlay component exists but is not mounted by the emergency root Testing Screen path, so on-screen runtime console is not currently verifiable from active root flow.

action_items: If user requires visible on-screen runtime console in the same emergency root build, mount StartupConsoleOverlay (or equivalent) in the active Testing Screen path.
Run GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch once to produce and install app-debug.apk on device for final physical freeze confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx is clean for strict emergency root: no static Expo Router/vector-icons/assets/auth/storage/API/AppRuntime imports.
SplashScreen.hideAsync has both onLayout trigger and watchdog timer path; this matches emergency release-safety intent.
AppErrorBoundary renders raw error name/message/JS stack/component stack directly onscreen with selectable text.
Font assets and app.json expo-font plugin entries are aligned and non-empty with lowercase Android aliases.
Self-contained debug behavior is wired in both Gradle (debuggableVariants cleared under CHINGU_SELF_CONTAINED_DEBUG) and MainApplication (developer support disabled when self-contained).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static checks passed: yarn lint, yarn tsc --noEmit, expo config output generation, mobile preview screenshot proof. Remaining verification is physical debug APK install/startup behavior and explicit runtime console visibility requirement alignment.
rca_of_issue: Potential requirement mismatch: strict emergency root currently renders only Testing Screen, while debug runtime console component exists separately and is not mounted in this root path. Repro: open preview and inspect mounted tree/state; only testing-screen testIDs appear. Mitigation: mount the console overlay in emergency root when diagnostics flag is enabled.
